passages.quote:
If you are an employer, you must use the standardised statement to inform workers of their right to join a trade union. You must not add further information to, or change the statement, except where the regulations require or permit this, as outlined in the guidance on informing workers of their right to join a trade union.

Employers can download or copy this to prepare their own statement.
